sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: NRN MI UPR LOW WILL LIFT NE INTO ONT AND WRN QB THIS PERIOD AS UPSTREAM DISTURBANCE NOW OVER NRN AB/SK AMPLIFIES SE INTO SRN MB. ON THE SRN FRINGE OF MI LOW...A SERIES OF WEAK IMPULSES...THE MOST IMPORTANT OF WHICH APPEARS TO BE OVER IND ATTM...WILL AFFECT THE OH VLY AND NERN U.S. IN THE WEST...ERN WA UPR LOW APPEARS TO BE ELONGATING ESEWD...MOST LIKELY IN RESPONSE TO RISING HEIGHTS IN BC. THE LOW SHOULD BE CENTERED OVER CNTRL ID BY 12Z MON. AT THE SFC...LEAD COLD FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH MI SYSTEM HAS ALL BUT WASHED OUT OVER THE NORTHEAST. REINFORCING FRONTOGENETIC ZONE NOW EXTENDING FROM THE LWR TN VLY TO MID OH VLY SHOULD CONTINUE GENERALLY ESE THROUGH THE PERIOD.

sections.title: MID ATLANTIC/NERN STATES
sections.text: AS LEAD COLD FRONT DISSIPATES AND UPR FLOW REMAINS SWLY AHEAD OF IND IMPULSE...PERSISTENT 25-30 KT SSWLY LLJ WILL ADVECT/MAINTAIN AXIS OF FAIRLY RICH MOISTURE /PW AOA 1.50 INCHES/ FROM MD/VA NEWD INTO WRN/SRN NEW ENGLAND. CLOUDS AND SHOWERS ASSOCIATED WITH LINGERING AREAS OF CONVECTION ALONG THE DISSPATING FRONT WILL SOMEWHAT LIMIT DIURNAL HEATING/DESTABLIZATION...ESPECIALLY FROM WV INTO CNTRL PA. BUT AT LEAST MODEST DESTABLIZATION SHOULD OCCUR FARTHER E AND N...WHERE POCKETS OF SBCAPE TO 2000 J/KG LIKELY WILL DEVELOP. BELT OF DEEP...SEASONABLY STRONG SWLY MID-UPR FLOW ALONG SE FRINGE OF MI LOW WILL MAINTAIN 30-40 KT BULK SHEAR ACROSS REGION THROUGH THE PERIOD. CLUSTERS/BANDS OF STORMS LIKELY WILL FORM IN WEAKLY CAPPED ENVIRONMENT FROM MD/VA NEWD INTO PARTS OF NY AND NEW ENGLAND BY EARLY AFTN AS IND UPR IMPULSE CONTINUES ENEWD. EMBEDDED SUSTAINED STORMS...SUPERCELLS AND LEWPS WITH BOWING SEGMENTS WILL YIELD DMGG WIND AND MARGINALLY SVR HAIL. A CONDITIONAL THREAT FOR TORNADOES WILL ALSO EXIST GIVEN STRENGTH OF 700 MB FLOW AND PRESENCE OF SUFFICIENT MOISTURE...MAINLY LATE THIS AFTN/EARLY THIS EVE FROM NJ INTO SERN NY/SW NEW ENGLAND. THE REALIZATION OF ANY SUCH THREAT WILL BE DEPENDEN

sections.title: LWR MS/TN VLYS
sections.text: SWRN PART OF REINFORCING COLD FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH IND UPR TROUGH WILL CONTINUE SLOWLY SEWD TODAY. POCKET OF STRONG INSTABILITY WILL PERSIST AHEAD OF FRONT...WHERE PW WILL REMAIN AOA 2 INCHES AND AFTN SBCAPE MAY EXCEED 2500 J/KG. ONGOING STORMS NEAR FRONT SHOULD STRENGTHEN...WITH ADDITIONAL ACTIVITY POSSIBLE FARTHER S AND E. MODEST WNWLY MID LVL FLOW WILL MAINTAIN SUFFICIENT DEEP SHEAR FOR STRONG MULTICELL CLUSTERS. THESE WILL POSE A THREAT FOR ISOLD DMGG WIND AND SVR HAIL THROUGH LATE EVE.

sections.title: CNTRL/SRN HI PLNS
sections.text: DIURNAL STORMS WILL ONCE AGAIN FORM OVER THE CO/NRN NM MOUNTAINS WITHIN PLUME OF DEEP MOISTURE ON NE FRINGE OF SWRN STATES UPR RIDGE. ACTIVITY WILL SUBSEQUENTLY MOVE/DEVELOP SE INTO THE ADJACENT HI PLNS...WHERE MODEST ELY POST FRONTAL FLOW WILL MAINTAIN SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE 50S F. A FEW STORMS WILL HAVE THE POTENTIAL TO PRODUCE ISOLD DOWNBURSTS AND SVR HAIL.

sections.title: NRN RCKYS
sections.text: STORMS WILL ALSO REDEVELOP OVER THE NRN RCKYS THIS AFTN AS WA UPR LOW ELOGATES ESEWD. NELY UPSLOPE COMPONENT SHOULD MAINTAIN SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE LOW 50S...WITH SBCAPE GENERALLY BELOW 1000 J/KG. BELT OF ENHANCED DEEP WLY SHEAR ON SRN FRINGE OF LOW WILL REMAIN SOMEWHAT REMOVED FROM AREA OF GREATEST INSTABILITY. BUT STEEP LOW LVL LAPSE RATES WILL NEVERTHELESS SUPPORT A THREAT FOR ISOLD DMGG WINDS WITH STRONGER STORMS. ..CORFIDI/GRAMS.. 07/26/2009

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS THE LOWER MS VALLEY
sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS FROM VA NEWD INTO NY AND WRN NEW ENGLAND...

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: UPPER LOW CENTERED OVER THE NRN GREAT LAKES WILL LIFT NEWD INTO ONTARIO/WRN QUEBEC AS A SERIES OF IMPULSES ROTATE THROUGH THE TROUGH AND AID IN CONVECTION. ONE SUCH WAVE/MCV WAS MOVING NEWD THROUGH NERN PA AND ANOTHER WAS SHIFTING ENEWD ACROSS THE OH VALLEY TOWARD THE NERN STATES. ERN WA UPR LOW IS FORECAST TO BEGIN MOVING SEWD AS HEIGHTS BUILD IN BRITISH COLUMBIA. AT THE SFC...REMNANT COLD FRONT...ROUGHLY DEFINED BY DEWPOINT DISCONTINUITY IN THE NERN STATES...STRETCHED FROM ERN NY/PA SWWD INTO NRN VA...THEN WSWWD THROUGH THE LOWER OH/TN VALLEYS AND INTO SRN OK/WRN TX.

sections.title: NRN NY AND VT
sections.text: INITIAL POTENTIAL FOR STRONGER CONVECTION ACROSS THE NERN STATES WILL BE OVER NRN NY AND VT AS MCV APPROACHES FROM THE SW. WEAK CAPPING INVERSION...MODEST INSTABILITY AND 30-40 KT DEEP LAYER SHEAR WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR SEVERE STORMS AND EVEN A SUPERCELL OR TWO THROUGH THE AFTERNOON HOURS.

sections.title: SRN NY/SRN NEW ENGLAND SWD INTO VA
sections.text: SKIES HAVE GENERALLY BEEN SUNNY FROM VA INTO SRN NJ THIS MORNING AND THIS HAS ALLOWED TEMPERATURES TO WARM INTO THE 80S. AS MCV SHIFTS NEWD...CLOUDS ARE EXPECTED TO DECREASE ACROSS SRN NY/SRN NEW ENGLAND. CONTINUED HEATING OF THE MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER...DEWPOINTS AROUND 70...AND 6.5 C/KM MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL YIELD MLCAPES AROUND 2000 J/KG ALONG AND EAST OF FRONT/DEWPOINT DISCONTINUITY. THE SEASONABLY STRONG SWLY MID-UPPER FLOW AND 30-40 KT OF EFFECTIVE SHEAR WILL LIKELY RESULT IN WELL ORGANIZED AND SUSTAINED STORMS...WITH SUPERCELLS AND BOWING SEGMENTS POSSIBLE. UNIDIRECTIONAL WINDS ABOVE THE BOUNDARY LAYER SUGGEST DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREAT. HAIL IS ALSO ANTICIPATED AND AN ISOLATED TORNADO OR TWO IS POSSIBLE ACROSS SRN NY/SWRN NEW ENGLAND IF S/SELY BOUNDARY LAYER WINDS CAN BE MAINTAINED THROUGH THE DAY.

sections.title: LOWER MS/TN VALLEYS
sections.text: ELEVATED THUNDERSTORMS ARE ONGOING FROM ERN TX EWD INTO MS. THESE STORMS WERE LIKELY SUPPORTED BY THE LOW LEVEL JET...BUT HAVE WEAKENED SOMEWHAT AS THE JET SPEEDS HAVE DECREASED. THOUGH SHEAR IS WEAK...VERY MOIST ENVIRONMENT AND CONTINUED WARM ADVECTION BETWEEN 700-850 MB IS EXPECTED TO MAINTAIN STORMS ACROSS THE LOWER MS VALLEY THROUGH THE AFTERNOON HOURS. PWAT/S NEARING 2 INCHES...LOW TO MID 70 DEWPOINTS AND 500 MB TEMPERATURES AROUND -10C WILL SUPPORT MLCAPES TO 3000 J/KG...WHERE STRONG HEATING OCCURS. IF THE STORMS CAN ORGANIZE AND FORM A COLD POOL...THE POTENTIAL FOR A SWD MOVING MCS...WITH NWLY FLOW ALOFT...WOULD ENHANCED THE POTENTIAL FOR WIND DAMAGE. ALTHOUGH A SEVERE STORM OR TWO ARE POSSIBLE ACROSS NRN AL/NRN GA AND INTO ERN TN...THE SEVERE THREAT APPEARS LOWER THAN ACROSS THE LOWER MS VALLEY DUE TO WEAKER CONVERGENCE AND MORE CLOUDINESS AHEAD OF THE FRONT.

sections.title: CENTRL/SRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: ONCE MID/HIGH LEVEL CLOUDS THIN AND STRONGER HEATING COMMENCES... SCATTERED STORMS ARE ONCE AGAIN EXPECTED TO INITIATE OVER THE CO/NERN NM MOUNTAINS. THEREAFTER...THE NWLY FLOW ALOFT AND INSTABILITY AXIS SHOULD CARRY THE STORMS SEWD INTO THE ADJACENT HIGH PLAINS. WEAK WINDS BETWEEN 500-700 MB SHOULD RESULT IN STRONG OUTFLOW/S AND THE POTENTIAL FOR A CLUSTER OR TWO TO ORGANIZE...WITH STRONG WINDS AND PERHAPS SOME HAIL.

sections.title: NRN ROCKIES
sections.text: STORMS WILL ALSO REDEVELOP OVER THE NRN RCKYS THIS AFTN...THOUGH STRONGER SHEAR ON THE SRN FRINGE OF THE UPPER LOW IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN WEST OF THE STRONGER INSTABILITY. HOWEVER...BY LATE AFTERNOON...A WELL MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER MAY SUPPORT A THREAT FOR STRONG AND GUSTY WINDS WITH STRONGER STORMS. ..IMY/GARNER.. 07/26/2009

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS PORTIONS NERN CONUS TO VA
sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS PORTIONS MS DELTA...W-CENTRAL GULF COASTAL REGION... CORRECTED FOR GEN TSTM ARROW --- UPDATES ---

sections.title: MS DELTA...W-CENTRAL GULF COASTAL REGION
sections.text: SPATIAL EXTENT OF SVR POTENTIAL CONTINUES TO COMPRESS COASTWARD AS REMNANTS OF EARLIER MULTICELLULAR COMPLEXES CONTINUE TO MOVE SWD ACROSS CENTRAL/WRN MS...NRN LA AND E TX. ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT ALONG OR JUST BEHIND LEADING OUTFLOW EDGES SHOULD REINFORCE ASSOCIATED COLD POOL...WHILE WIDELY SCATTERED CONVECTION NOW DEVELOPING IN WEAKLY CAPPED AIR MASS AHEAD OF BOUNDARY MAY COALESCE INTO MORE ORGANIZED MULTICELLULAR CLUSTERS WITH DAMAGING GUSTS POSSIBLE. BOUNDARY COLLISIONS BETWEEN SWD PROPAGATING OUTFLOWS AND SEA BREEZE ALSO MAY YIELD SHORT-TERM ERUPTION OF TSTMS AS WELL IN ENVIRONMENT CHARACTERIZED BY SFC DEW POINTS 70S F...SUPPORTING ANTECEDENT MLCAPE 1500-2500 J/KG.

sections.title: NERN CONUS TO VA
sections.text: MINOR ADJUSTMENTS MADE TO REFLECT CURRENT AND NOWCAST CONVECTIVE/DESTABILIZATION TRENDS...AS DIURNAL CONVECTION CONTINUES TO INTENSIFY AND INCREASE IN COVERAGE IN SEVERAL BKN BANDS AND SMALL CLUSTERS AHEAD OF FRONT. MAIN THREAT REMAINS DAMAGING DOWNDRAFT GUSTS...THOUGH LARGE HAIL AND A TORNADO OR TWO ARE POSSIBLE FROM ANY SUSTAINED/DISCRETE SUPERCELLS ESPECIALLY OVER ERN MID-ATLANTIC REGION AND SRN NEW ENGLAND. REF MCD 1680...WWS 625-626 AND SUBSEQUENT MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS FOR NEAR-TERM GUIDANCE. ..EDWARDS.. 07/26/2009 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1130 AM CDT SUN JUL 26 2009/
